title: Chipperfield R8-24 Ultra-Compact Ride-On Mower with Automatic Transmission
description_html:
Chipperfield R8-24 Ultra-Compact Ride-On Mower – Introductory Offer

Compact, Powerful & Versatile Lawn Care

Designed for medium to large gardens, the Chipperfield R8-24 combines impressive performance, excellent manoeuvrability and versatile grass management in a compact ride-on mower. Powered by a dependable 224cc 4-stroke petrol engine, it is ideal for maintaining lawns up to 3,000m², delivering a clean, consistent finish every time.

Dimensions

  • Length: 180cm (with grass collector) / 135cm (without grass collector)
  • Width: 70cm
  • Height: 105cm

Powerful Performance & Simple Operation

At the heart of the R8-24 is a reliable 224cc single-cylinder 4-stroke petrol engine, producing 6hp (4.4kW) of power. An electric key start provides effortless starting, while a recoil back-up starter offers added peace of mind should the battery become flat.

The automatic CVT transmission is controlled by a foot pedal, allowing smooth forward and reverse operation while giving you complete control over your mowing speed. This makes it easy to adapt to changing lawn conditions without the need for manual gear changes.

Versatile Cutting & Grass Management

The 61cm cutting deck is perfectly suited to medium and larger gardens, while eight cutting height positions (30-75mm) allow you to tailor the finish throughout the growing season.

The R8-24 offers three practical grass management options:

  • Collect into the 150-litre grass collector
  • Side discharge for faster mowing of longer grass
  • Mulch grass clippings to return valuable nutrients back into the lawn

The generous grass collector reduces the number of stops required for emptying, helping you work more efficiently.

Comfort & Manoeuvrability

Weighing approximately 128kg, the Chipperfield R8-24 has been designed with manoeuvrability in mind. Its compact footprint, comfortable driving position and tight turning circle make it easy to work around trees, borders and garden obstacles while reducing operator fatigue.

Durable Construction & Practical Features

Built for long-lasting reliability, the R8-24 features a durable steel cutting deck fitted with a high-quality steel blade. A manual PTO (Power Take-Off) provides simple engagement of the cutting deck, while practical features such as the deck wash port make cleaning quick and straightforward after use.

Every aspect of the mower has been designed to maximise productivity, ease of use and dependable performance.

Warranty

For added confidence, the Chipperfield R8-24 is backed by a 2-year domestic warranty, providing reassurance of its quality and durability.

Final Verdict

The Chipperfield R8-24 Ultra-Compact Ride-On Mower is an excellent choice for homeowners seeking a compact yet capable ride-on mower. Its powerful engine, automatic transmission, three-way grass management system and comfortable operation make it ideal for maintaining medium to large lawns with ease.

Pros

  • ✅ Powerful 224cc (6hp / 4.4kW) 4-stroke petrol engine
  • ✅ Electric key start with recoil back-up starter
  • ✅ Smooth automatic CVT transmission with foot pedal control
  • ✅ 61cm cutting width with eight cutting height settings (30-75mm)
  • ✅ Collect, side discharge or mulch grass clippings
  • ✅ Large 150-litre grass collector
  • ✅ Compact design with excellent manoeuvrability
  • ✅ Durable steel construction and quality components

Overall Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4.9/5)

A compact, feature-packed ride-on mower that delivers impressive performance, versatility and ease of use, making it an excellent choice for maintaining medium to large gardens.

This price is an introductory offer that will be increased at the end of Jul 2026.
